sentences.japanese: あの占い師はうそつき同然だ。
sentences.english: That fortune-teller is no better than a liar.

sentences.japanese: 内弟子とは師と寝食をともにし、あらゆる武術のノウハウと秘伝を伝える制度だ。
sentences.english: Apprenticeship is a system where you eat, sleep and live with your master and are taught various martial arts know-how and secrets.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は彼を師と考えている。
sentences.english: She regards him as her master.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は彼を師と仰いでいる。
sentences.english: She looks on him as her master.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は、彼はペテン師だ、とまで言った。
sentences.english: She went so far as to say that he was a swindler.
